```{ojs}
catData = FileAttachment("data/catalogue.json").json()
protSummary = catData.protein_summary
protIndex = catData.proteins_index
cohortsAll = catData.cohort_membership
strataById = new Map(catData.strata.map(s => [s.stratum_id, s]))
cohortsByStudy = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const c of cohortsAll) {
    if (!m.has(c.study_id)) m.set(c.study_id, []);
    m.get(c.study_id).push(c);
  }
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Single 6-box top row: Box 1 = Protein Search (persistent focus) + Boxes 2–6 = Protein Info (+ open GW), Cohorts, Max N by Population, Platforms, Matrices & Flags
{
  let matches = [];
  let activeIdx = -1;

  const menu = htl.html`<div class="typeahead-menu"></div>`;
  const boxProt = htl.html`<div class="kpi-card"></div>`;
  const boxCohorts = htl.html`<div class="kpi-card"></div>`;
  const boxMaxN = htl.html`<div class="kpi-card"></div>`;
  const boxPlats = htl.html`<div class="kpi-card"></div>`;
  const boxMatrices = htl.html`<div class="kpi-card"></div>`;

  function updateSummaryBoxes(uniprot) {
    const pm = protSummary.find(p => p.uniprot === uniprot) || protSummary[0] || {
      uniprot: "—", gene_symbol: "None", protein_name: "No protein assay index loaded",
      n_studies: 0, n_strata: 0, n_assays_total: 0
    };
    const rows = pm.uniprot === "—"
      ? []
      : protIndex
          .filter(r => r.uniprot === pm.uniprot)
          .map(r => ({ ...(strataById.get(r.stratum_id) || {}), ...r }))
          .filter(r => r.status !== "Superseded Preprint");

    const studyIds = new Set(rows.map(r => r.study_id));
    const openGwStudies = new Set(
      rows.filter(r => r.data_label === "Genome-wide" && r.access_short === "open").map(r => r.study_id)
    );
    const totalGwStrata = new Set(
      rows.filter(r => r.data_label === "Genome-wide").map(r => r.stratum_id)
    ).size;

    // Box 2: Protein info + Open-access genome-wide studies count
    boxProt.replaceChildren(
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-label">PROTEIN</div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-value" style="font-size:1.18rem;">${pm.gene_symbol} <span class="mono" style="font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:500;color:#64748b;">(${pm.uniprot})</span></div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-sub" style="white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;" title=${pm.protein_name}>${pm.protein_name}</div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-sub" style="margin-top:0.22rem;">
        <span class="pg-badge data-gw">${openGwStudies.size} open GW ${openGwStudies.size === 1 ? "study" : "studies"}</span>
        <span style="margin-left:3px;font-size:0.72rem;">(${totalGwStrata} GW strata)</span>
      </div>`
    );

    // Box 3: Cohorts measured in (+ studies count)
    const cohMaxN = new Map();
    for (const sid of studyIds) {
      for (const c of (cohortsByStudy.get(sid) || [])) {
        const nVal = Number(c.n_cohort) || 0;
        if (!cohMaxN.has(c.cohort) || nVal > cohMaxN.get(c.cohort)) {
          cohMaxN.set(c.cohort, nVal);
        }
      }
    }
    const sortedCohorts = Array.from(cohMaxN.entries())
      .sort((a, b) => (b[1] - a[1]) || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
      .map(x => x[0]);
    const topCohorts = sortedCohorts.slice(0, 4);
    const extraCohorts = sortedCohorts.length - topCohorts.length;
    const allCohortsTooltip = sortedCohorts.join(", ");

    boxCohorts.replaceChildren(
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-label">COHORTS &amp; STUDIES</div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-value" style="font-size:1.18rem;">${sortedCohorts.length} <span style="font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:500;color:#64748b;">cohorts (${studyIds.size} studies)</span></div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-sub" title=${allCohortsTooltip} style="line-height:1.35;">
        ${topCohorts.length ? topCohorts.join(", ") : "—"}
        ${extraCohorts > 0 ? htl.html` <span class="pg-badge overlap-yes" style="font-size:0.68rem;padding:0.06rem 0.36rem;cursor:help;" title=${allCohortsTooltip}>+${extraCohorts} more</span>` : ""}
      </div>`
    );

    // Box 4: Max N for each POPULATION
    const popOrder = ["EUR", "MULTI", "AFR", "EAS", "CSA", "AMR", "MID"];
    const popMax = [];
    for (const pop of popOrder) {
      const sub = rows.filter(r => r.pop_super === pop);
      if (sub.length > 0) {
        popMax.push({ pop, maxN: Math.max(...sub.map(r => Number(r.n_samples) || 0)) });
      }
    }
    boxMaxN.replaceChildren(
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-label">MAX N BY POPULATION</div>`,
      popMax.length > 0
        ? htl.html`<div class="kpi-mini-grid">
            ${popMax.map(x => htl.html`<div class="kpi-mini-item" title="${x.pop}: max N = ${x.maxN.toLocaleString()}">
              <span class="mono" style="font-weight:600;">${x.pop}</span>
              <strong class="mono">${fmtCompactN(x.maxN)}</strong>
            </div>`)}
          </div>`
        : htl.html`<div class="kpi-sub">—</div>`
    );

    // Box 5: Platforms breakdown
    const platOrder = ["Olink", "SomaScan", "Mass Spectrometry", "Luminex", "Other Immunoassay", "NULISA"];
    const platShort = { "Mass Spectrometry": "MS", "Other Immunoassay": "Other" };
    const platCounts = [];
    for (const p of platOrder) {
      const n = rows.filter(r => r.platform_category === p).length;
      if (n > 0) platCounts.push({ label: platShort[p] || p, full: p, count: n });
    }
    platCounts.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
    boxPlats.replaceChildren(
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-label">PLATFORMS (${rows.length} ASSAYS)</div>`,
      platCounts.length > 0
        ? htl.html`<div class="kpi-mini-grid">
            ${platCounts.map(p => htl.html`<div class="kpi-mini-item" title="${p.full}: ${p.count} assay records">
              <span>${p.label}</span>
              <strong class="mono">${p.count}</strong>
            </div>`)}
          </div>`
        : htl.html`<div class="kpi-sub">—</div>`
    );

    // Box 6: Sample matrices & cis-pQTL / PAV summary
    const uniqMatrices = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(r => r.sample_matrix).filter(Boolean)));
    const cisStudies = new Set(rows.filter(r => isTrueVal(r.cis_pqtl_reported)).map(r => r.study_id)).size;
    const pavStudies = new Set(rows.filter(r => isTrueVal(r.pav_epitope_flag)).map(r => r.study_id)).size;
    boxMatrices.replaceChildren(
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-label">MATRICES &amp; QTL FLAGS</div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-value" style="font-size:1.12rem;">${uniqMatrices.length} <span style="font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:500;color:#64748b;">${uniqMatrices.length === 1 ? "matrix" : "matrices"}</span></div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-sub" title=${uniqMatrices.join(", ")} style="white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">${uniqMatrices.join(", ") || "—"}</div>`,
      htl.html`<div class="kpi-sub" style="margin-top:0.2rem;">
        <em>cis</em>-pQTL: <strong>${cisStudies}</strong> · PAV: <strong>${pavStudies}</strong>
      </div>`
    );
  }

  const closeMenu = () => {
    menu.style.display = "none";
    menu.replaceChildren();
    matches = [];
    activeIdx = -1;
  };

  const selectProtein = (p) => {
    mutable selectedUniprot = p.uniprot;
    updateSummaryBoxes(p.uniprot);
    searchInput.value = `${p.gene_symbol} (${p.uniprot})`;
    closeMenu();
  };

  const elevateAncestors = () => {
    let anc = searchInput.parentElement;
    while (anc && anc !== document.body) {
      anc.style.overflow = "visible";
      if (anc.classList && (anc.classList.contains("cell") || anc.classList.contains("cell-output-display") || anc.classList.contains("observablehq"))) {
        anc.style.position = "relative";
        anc.style.zIndex = "100";
      }
      anc = anc.parentElement;
    }
  };

  const renderMenu = () => {
    if (matches.length === 0) {
      closeMenu();
      return;
    }
    elevateAncestors();
    const items = matches.map((p, idx) =>
      htl.html`<div
        class="typeahead-item ${idx === activeIdx ? "is-active" : ""}"
        onmousedown=${e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          selectProtein(p);
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <strong>${p.gene_symbol}</strong>
          <span class="mono" style="color:#64748b;margin-left:4px;">(${p.uniprot})</span>
          <span style="color:#475569;margin-left:6px;">${p.protein_name}</span>
        </div>
        <span class="mono" style="color:#64748b;white-space:nowrap;">${p.n_studies} studies</span>
      </div>`
    );
    menu.replaceChildren(...items);
    menu.style.display = "block";
  };

  const handleInput = (raw) => {
    const q = (raw || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) {
      closeMenu();
      return;
    }

    const scored = [];
    for (const p of protSummary) {
      const gs = p.gene_symbol.toLowerCase();
      const up = p.uniprot.toLowerCase();
      const nm = p.protein_name.toLowerCase();
      let rank = 99;
      if (gs === q || up === q) rank = 1;
      else if (gs.startsWith(q) || up.startsWith(q)) rank = 2;
      else if (nm.startsWith(q)) rank = 3;
      else if (`${gs} ${up} ${nm}`.includes(q)) rank = 4;
      if (rank < 99) scored.push({ p, rank });
    }
    scored.sort((a, b) => (a.rank - b.rank) || a.p.gene_symbol.localeCompare(b.p.gene_symbol));
    matches = scored.slice(0, 10).map(s => s.p);
    activeIdx = matches.length > 0 ? 0 : -1;
    renderMenu();

    const exact = protSummary.find(p => p.gene_symbol.toLowerCase() === q || p.uniprot.toLowerCase() === q);
    if (exact) {
      mutable selectedUniprot = exact.uniprot;
      updateSummaryBoxes(exact.uniprot);
    }
  };

  const searchInput = htl.html`<input
    class="col-filter-input"
    autocomplete="off"
    spellcheck="false"
    style="width:100%;font-size:0.82rem;padding:0.38rem 0.55rem;margin-top:0.22rem;"
    type="search"
    placeholder="Search IL6, P05231..."
    oninput=${e => handleInput(e.target.value)}
    onkeydown=${e => {
      if (menu.style.display === "none" || matches.length === 0) return;
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        activeIdx = (activeIdx + 1) % matches.length;
        renderMenu();
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        activeIdx = (activeIdx - 1 + matches.length) % matches.length;
        renderMenu();
      } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (activeIdx >= 0 && matches[activeIdx]) selectProtein(matches[activeIdx]);
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        closeMenu();
      }
    }}
    onblur=${() => setTimeout(closeMenu, 120)}
  >`;

  updateSummaryBoxes("P05231");

  return htl.html`<div class="pg-shell lookup-search-shell" style="padding-bottom:0;">
    <div class="kpi-grid-6">
      <div class="kpi-card kpi-card-search">
        <div class="kpi-label">PROTEIN LOOKUP</div>
        <div class="typeahead-wrap">
          ${searchInput}
          ${menu}
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-sub" style="margin-top:0.28rem;">Gene, UniProt ID, or protein name</div>
      </div>
      ${boxProt}
      ${boxCohorts}
      ${boxMaxN}
      ${boxPlats}
      ${boxMatrices}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
  ? []

       .filter(r => r.uniprot === activeProtMeta.uniprot)
       .map(r => ({ ...(strataById.get(r.stratum_id) || {}), ...r }))
```

```{ojs}
// Reusable Catalogue-style Full-Width Paginated Table for the Selected Protein (synced 2-row dropdown)
{
  const rowsSource = activeProtRows;
  const state = {
    sortCol: "n",
    sortAsc: false,
    pageSize: 10,
    page: 1,
    expanded: new Set(),
    filters: {
      author: "",
      year: "",
      cohort: "",
      overlap: "",
      population: "",
      sex: "",
      n: "",
      sample: "",
      platform: "",
      assay: "",
      data: ""
    }
  };

  const countSpan = htl.html`<span></span>`;
  const pageInfoSpan = htl.html`<span></span>`;

  const clearBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" style="display:none;padding:0.2rem 0.55rem;font-size:0.74rem;" onclick=${() => {
    for (const k of Object.keys(state.filters)) state.filters[k] = "";
    for (const el of filterInputs) el.value = "";
    state.page = 1;
    renderRows();
  }}>✕ Clear filters</button>`;

  const pageSizeSelect = htl.html`<select class="col-filter-select" style="width:auto;min-width:68px;" onchange=${e => {
    state.pageSize = e.target.value === "all" ? Infinity : Number(e.target.value);
    state.page = 1;
    renderRows();
  }}>
    <option value="10" selected>10</option>
    <option value="20">20</option>
    <option value="50">50</option>
    <option value="all">All</option>
  </select>`;

  const prevBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" onclick=${() => {
    if (state.page > 1) {
      state.page -= 1;
      renderRows();
    }
  }}>← Previous</button>`;

  const nextBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" onclick=${() => {
    state.page += 1;
    renderRows();
  }}>Next →</button>`;

  const cols = [
    { key: "author",     label: "AUTHOR"     },
    { key: "year",       label: "YEAR"       },
    { key: "cohort",     label: "COHORT"     },
    { key: "overlap",    label: "OVERLAP"    },
    { key: "population", label: "POPULATION" },
    { key: "sex",        label: "SEX"        },
    { key: "n",          label: "N"          },
    { key: "sample",     label: "SAMPLE"     },
    { key: "platform",   label: "PLATFORM"   },
    { key: "assay",      label: "ASSAY"      },
    { key: "data",       label: "DATA"       }
  ];

  const sortIndicators = {};
  const sortHeaders = cols.map(col => {
    const ind = htl.html`<span style="opacity:0.55;margin-left:3px;font-size:0.68rem;">↕</span>`;
    sortIndicators[col.key] = ind;
    return htl.html`<th onclick=${() => {
      if (state.sortCol === col.key) state.sortAsc = !state.sortAsc;
      else {
        state.sortCol = col.key;
        state.sortAsc = ["year", "n", "overlap"].includes(col.key) ? false : true;
      }
      state.page = 1;
      renderRows();
    }}>${col.label}${ind}</th>`;
  });

  const filterInputs = [];
  const makeTextFilter = (key, placeholder) => {
    const inp = htl.html`<input class="col-filter-input" type="text" placeholder=${placeholder} oninput=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      state.page = 1;
      renderRows();
    }}>`;
    filterInputs.push(inp);
    return inp;
  };
  const makeSelectFilter = (key, options) => {
    const sel = htl.html`<select class="col-filter-select" onchange=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      state.page = 1;
      renderRows();
    }}>
      <option value="">All</option>
      ${options.map(o => htl.html`<option value=${o}>${o}</option>`)}
    </select>`;
    filterInputs.push(sel);
    return sel;
  };

  const filterRow = htl.html`<tr class="filter-row">
    <th>${makeTextFilter("author", "Author / PMID...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("year", "e.g. 2023")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("cohort", "UKB, INTERVAL...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("overlap", "None, >0, ID...")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("population", ["EUR", "AFR", "EAS", "CSA", "AMR", "MID", "MULTI"])}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("sex", ["Combined", "Female", "Male"])}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("n", ">=1000")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("sample", "Plasma, serum...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("platform", "SomaScan, Olink...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("assay", "OID / SeqId...")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("data", ["Genome-wide", "Gene-region", "Top-hits", "Unavailable"])}</th>
  </tr>`;

  const tbody = htl.html`<tbody></tbody>`;

  function getFiltered() {
    const f = state.filters;
    const rows = rowsSource.filter(d => {
      if (f.author && !`${d.first_author} ${d.pmid || ""} ${d.doi || ""} ${d.study_id}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.author.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.year && !matchNumericFilter(d.year, f.year)) return false;
      if (f.cohort && !d.cohorts_display.toLowerCase().includes(f.cohort.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.overlap) {
        const q = f.overlap.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (q === ">0" || q === "yes") {
          if (d.overlap_count === 0) return false;
        } else if (!`${d.overlap_compact} ${d.overlap_ids}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      }
      if (f.population && d.pop_super !== f.population) return false;
      if (f.sex && d.sex !== f.sex) return false;
      if (f.n && !matchNumericFilter(d.n_samples, f.n)) return false;
      if (f.sample && !d.sample_matrix.toLowerCase().includes(f.sample.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.platform && !`${d.platform_category} ${d.platform_version}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.platform.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.assay && !`${d.assay_id} ${d.n_assays}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.assay.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.data && d.data_label !== f.data) return false;
      return true;
    });

    const dir = state.sortAsc ? 1 : -1;
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (state.sortCol) {
        case "author":     return dir * (a.first_author.localeCompare(b.first_author) || (b.year - a.year));
        case "year":       return dir * ((a.year - b.year) || (a.n_samples - b.n_samples));
        case "cohort":     return dir * a.cohorts_display.localeCompare(b.cohorts_display);
        case "overlap":    return dir * (a.overlap_count - b.overlap_count);
        case "population": return dir * a.pop_super.localeCompare(b.pop_super);
        case "sex":        return dir * a.sex.localeCompare(b.sex);
        case "n":          return dir * (a.n_samples - b.n_samples);
        case "sample":     return dir * a.sample_matrix.localeCompare(b.sample_matrix);
        case "platform":   return dir * a.platform_version.localeCompare(b.platform_version);
        case "assay":      return dir * a.assay_id.localeCompare(b.assay_id);
        case "data":       return dir * a.data_label.localeCompare(b.data_label);
        default:           return dir * (a.n_samples - b.n_samples);
      }
    });
    return rows;
  }

  function renderRows() {
    for (const c of cols) {
      const ind = sortIndicators[c.key];
      if (state.sortCol === c.key) {
        ind.textContent = state.sortAsc ? " ↑" : " ↓";
        ind.style.opacity = "1";
      } else {
        ind.textContent = " ↕";
        ind.style.opacity = "0.45";
      }
    }
    clearBtn.style.display = Object.values(state.filters).some(v => v && v.trim() !== "") ? "inline-flex" : "none";

    const allRows = getFiltered();
    const total = allRows.length;
    const totalPages = state.pageSize === Infinity ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / state.pageSize));
    if (state.page > totalPages) state.page = totalPages;

    const startIdx = state.pageSize === Infinity ? 0 : (state.page - 1) * state.pageSize;
    const endIdx   = state.pageSize === Infinity ? total : Math.min(total, startIdx + state.pageSize);
    const pageRows = allRows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

    countSpan.textContent = total === 0
      ? `0 matching records for ${activeProtMeta.gene_symbol}`
      : `Showing ${startIdx + 1}–${endIdx} of ${total} records for ${activeProtMeta.gene_symbol} · Click any row to expand`;
    pageInfoSpan.textContent = `Page ${state.page} of ${totalPages}`;
    prevBtn.disabled = state.page <= 1;
    nextBtn.disabled = state.page >= totalPages;

    const trs = [];
    for (const d of pageRows) {
      const rowKey = `${d.stratum_id}__${d.assay_id}`;
      const isOpen = state.expanded.has(rowKey);
      const toggle = () => {
        if (state.expanded.has(rowKey)) state.expanded.delete(rowKey);
        else state.expanded.add(rowKey);
        renderRows();
      };

      trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="data-row ${isOpen ? "is-open" : ""}" onclick=${toggle}>
        <td>
          <div style="font-weight:600;color:#0f172a;">
            <span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;color:#64748b;font-size:0.7rem;">${isOpen ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
            ${d.first_author}
          </div>
          <div class="mono" style="color:#64748b;padding-left:12px;">
            ${d.pmid ? d.pmid : "Preprint"}
          </div>
        </td>
        <td class="num-col">${d.year}</td>
        <td>${d.cohorts_display}</td>
        <td class="center-col">
          ${d.overlap_count > 0
            ? htl.html`<span class="pg-badge overlap-yes">${d.overlap_compact}</span>`
            : htl.html`<span class="overlap-none">None</span>`}
        </td>
        <td class="mono center-col"><strong>${d.pop_super}</strong></td>
        <td class="center-col">${d.sex}</td>
        <td class="num-col"><strong>${fmtInt(d.n_samples)}</strong></td>
        <td>${d.sample_matrix}</td>
        <td class="center-col">
          <span class="pg-badge ${platBadgeClass(d.platform_category)}">${d.platform_category}</span>
          <div style="font-size:0.71rem;color:#64748b;margin-top:1px;">${d.platform_version}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="num-col"><span class="mono" style="font-weight:600;color:#0f4c81;">${d.assay_id}</span></td>
        <td class="center-col"><span class="pg-badge ${dataBadgeClass(d.data_label)}">${d.data_label}</span></td>
      </tr>`);

      if (isOpen) {
        trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="detail-row">
          <td colspan="11">${renderExpandedDetail(d, { isLookup: true })}</td>
        </tr>`);
      }
    }

    if (trs.length === 0) {
      trs.push(htl.html`<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;color:#64748b;">No studies match the current column filters.</td></tr>`);
    }
    tbody.replaceChildren(...trs);
  }

  renderRows();

  return htl.html`<div class="pg-shell" style="padding-top:0;padding-bottom:1rem;">
    <div class="table-toolbar">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        ${countSpan}
        ${clearBtn}
      </div>
      <div class="page-controls">
        <span>Rows:</span>
        ${pageSizeSelect}
        ${prevBtn}
        ${pageInfoSpan}
        ${nextBtn}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="cat-table-wrap">
      <table class="cat-table">
        <thead>
          <tr class="sort-row">${sortHeaders}</tr>
          ${filterRow}
        </thead>
        ${tbody}
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

        ]
      },
      y: {

        grid: true

        range: ["#4338ca", "#0d9488", "#d97706", "#db2777", "#64748b", "#475569"]
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.dot(activeProtRows, {
          x: d => d.year + (d.pop_super === "EUR" ? -0.07 : d.pop_super === "MULTI" ? 0 : 0.1),
          y: "n_samples",
          r: "n_assays",
          fill: "platform_category",
          fillOpacity: d => d.status === "Preprint" ? 0.45 : 0.8,
          stroke: "platform_category",
          strokeWidth: d => d.status === "Preprint" ? 2 : 1,
          strokeDasharray: d => d.status === "Preprint" ? "3,2" : null,
          tip: true,
          title: d => `${d.first_author} (${d.year})\n${d.study_id}\n${fmtInt(d.n_samples)} | ${d.pop_super}\n${d.data_label}`
        })
      ]
    })}
  </div>
</div>`
